decisions.choice: Job went on: he speaks again with no friend answering in between
alternatives: Job answered (as at the start of the earlier speeches)
decisions.reason: Every speech so far has opened with "answered and said" (3:2; 4:1; 6:1 ... 26:1). Here the words are different: Job "added" to his speech, that is, he continued. Bildad's last speech (chapter 25) was short, and Zophar, who spoke in chapters 11 and 20, does not speak a third time. The same words open 29:1.

decisions.choice: discourse: a weighty speech, a poem with a lesson
decisions.reason: Mashal is a proverb or a solemn poem that teaches, like Balaam's oracles (Numbers 23:7) or a wisdom psalm (Psalm 49:5; 78:2). It marks what follows as a considered address, not only a reply.

decisions.choice: took up his discourse again (B), spoke again (R)
alternatives: continued to take up his discourse
decisions.reason: Hebrew says Job "added to take up": he did it again. Balanced says "again"; Readable says simply that he spoke again, following the book-wide pattern for speech openings.

decisions.choice: o seu discurso
decisions.reason: The word (mashal) is a weighty, teaching speech here (m2). "Provérbio" or "parábola", the older renderings, would suggest a short saying or a story; "discurso" says that Job now makes a considered address. Literal "continuou" keeps the Hebrew "added" (m1).

pt.L: [Tão certo como] vive Deus, [que] tirou o meu direito, \q e o Todo-Poderoso, [que] amargurou a minha alma,
pt.B: Tão certo como vive Deus, que me negou justiça, \q e o Todo-Poderoso, que encheu de amargura a minha vida,

decisions.choice: as God lives: a solemn oath
decisions.reason: "As God lives" opens an oath (Ruth 3:13; 1 Samuel 14:39; 20:3). What Job swears follows in 27:3-4. He swears by the life of the very God he says has wronged him: he still holds to God while accusing him.

decisions.choice: my right: the justice I am owed, a fair verdict
decisions.reason: Mishpat is the verdict or the right a person is owed in court. Job says God has kept him from getting justice (19:7). Elihu later quotes these words against him (34:5).

decisions.choice: the Almighty has made my soul bitter
decisions.reason: Naomi said almost the same of herself: "the Almighty has made me very bitter" (Ruth 1:20). Soul (nefesh) is the whole person, so the bitterness is in Job's whole life. On the Almighty (Shaddai) see 5:17.

decisions.choice: I swear by the living God
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that Job is taking an oath (m1), since "as God lives" is no longer a familiar way to swear.

decisions.choice: « Aussi vrai que Dieu est vivant »
decisions.reason: French opens an oath by the living God with « aussi vrai que … est vivant » (meaning decision m1); Readable says « Je le jure », as the English does.

decisions.choice: the plain style for the oath (27:2-4, 6-10) and the poem on the wicked (27:13-23); 하오체 with 그대들 only where Job speaks to the friends (27:5, 11-12)
decisions.reason: Korean keeps the 하오체 used between Job and his friends for lines addressed to them; the oath, Job's words about himself and the description of the fate of the wicked do not address anyone and are set in the plain written style of a poem.

decisions.choice: "[Tão certo como] vive Deus" (L); "Tão certo como vive Deus" (B); "Eu juro pelo Deus que vive" (R)
decisions.reason: The oath formula (m1) in the wording the Portuguese of Ruth 3:13 and 1 Samuel 14:39 and 20:3 uses, "tão certo como ... vive", with the brackets at Literal where the Hebrew has only "life of God". Readable says plainly that Job takes an oath, as the English Readable does. "Amargurou a minha alma" (L) keeps the echo of Naomi's words in Ruth 1:20 (m3).

decisions.choice: as long as: the whole time that
alternatives: for my breath is still wholly in me
decisions.reason: "All still" means "all the while". The words set how long the oath holds: as long as Job lives. The opening ki here belongs to the oath and does not give a reason.

decisions.choice: the breath of God in my nostrils: life as God's gift
decisions.reason: God breathed the breath of life into the first man's nostrils (Genesis 2:7). Job says his life is breath from God, as Elihu also says (33:4) and as 34:14-15 says God could take back.

decisions.choice: breath (ruach), not spirit
decisions.reason: Ruach is paired here with neshamah, "breath", and placed in the nostrils, so it means the breath of life.

decisions.choice: as long as I am alive / God's breath of life
alternatives: as long as my breath is in me
decisions.reason: Readable says what having breath means, being alive, and adds "of life" to show that God's breath is what keeps Job alive (m2).

decisions.choice: "if" in an oath: surely not
decisions.reason: In a Hebrew oath, "if" with the curse left unsaid ("may God punish me if ...") means "certainly not" (Genesis 14:23; 1 Samuel 3:17; Psalm 95:11). Job swears that he will not speak falsely.

decisions.choice: injustice, deceit: here, a false confession of guilt
decisions.reason: The next verses show what lie Job refuses to tell: to agree with the friends that he deserves his suffering (27:5-6) would be untrue.

decisions.choice: lips ... tongue become plain speech at Readable
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps lips and tongue; Readable says "I will never say", since the body parts stand for Job's speaking.

pt.R: Eu nunca vou dizer que vocês têm razão. \q Até o dia da minha morte não vou abrir mão da minha integridade.

decisions.choice: far be it from me: a strong refusal
decisions.reason: The word comes from a root meaning "profane": it would be an unholy thing for me (Genesis 18:25; 1 Samuel 24:7).

decisions.choice: declare you right: grant that you are in the right in this dispute
decisions.reason: This form of the verb is a court word: to declare someone in the right (Deuteronomy 25:1). "You" is plural, the friends. Job will not concede their case against him.

decisions.choice: integrity: the wholeness of a blameless life
decisions.reason: Tummah comes from the same root as "blameless" (1:1). God said Job still held to his integrity (2:3), and his wife asked why he did (2:9). Job now swears to keep it.

decisions.choice: plural_you where Job speaks to the three friends (27:5, 11-12)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew 'you' is plural (meaning decision m2): Job addresses all three friends, so Spanish uses the plural_you setting.

ko.L: 나는 내 의를 굳게 붙잡았으니 놓지 않을 것이다. \q 내 마음은 내 날들 중 어느 날에 대해서도 \q [나를] 책망하지 않는다.
ko.B: 나는 내 의를 붙들고 놓지 않을 것이다. \q 내 양심은 내 삶의 어느 하루에 대해서도 \q 나를 탓하지 않는다.
ko.R: 나는 내가 옳게 살았다는 주장을 굳게 붙들고 놓지 않겠다. \q 내 양심은 내 삶의 어느 하루도 나를 고발하지 않는다.

pt.L: Agarrei-me à minha justiça e não a largarei; \q o meu coração não [me] censura \q por nenhum dos meus dias.
pt.B: Eu me apego à minha justiça e não vou largá-la; \q a minha consciência não me acusa \q por nenhum dia da minha vida.
pt.R: Vou continuar afirmando que fiz o que é certo, e não vou desistir disso. \q A minha consciência não me acusa por nenhum dia da minha vida.

decisions.choice: my righteousness: my being in the right in this case
decisions.reason: Job does not claim never to have sinned (7:21; 13:26). He claims that he has done nothing to deserve what has happened and that his cause is just.

decisions.choice: my heart does not reproach me: my conscience is clear
decisions.reason: The heart can strike or rebuke a person, as David's heart struck him (1 Samuel 24:6; 25:31). It is what we call the conscience.

decisions.choice: for any of my days: about any day of my life
alternatives: as long as I live (my heart will not reproach me)
decisions.reason: "From my days" can mean that no day of Job's past gives his conscience cause to accuse him, or that it will not accuse him for the rest of his life. The first fits the claim of the first line.

decisions.choice: conscience
decisions.reason: In English, the heart does not reproach anyone; the conscience does (m2).

source.text: יְהִ֣י כְ֭רָשָׁע אֹ֣יְבִ֑י וּמִתְקוֹמְמִ֥י כְעַוָּֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: May be like [the] wicked my enemy, and [the one] raising himself against me like [the] unjust.

en.L: May my enemy be like the wicked, \q and the one who rises against me like the unjust.
en.B: Let my enemy be like the wicked, \q and my opponent like the unrighteous.
en.R: May my enemy end up like the wicked. \q May the one who attacks me be treated like someone who does evil.

es.L: Sea como el malvado mi enemigo, \q y el que se levanta contra mí como el injusto.
es.B: Que mi enemigo sea como el malvado, \q y mi adversario como el injusto.
es.R: Que mi enemigo acabe como los malvados. \q Que al que me ataca se le trate como a quien hace el mal.

fr.L: Que mon ennemi soit comme le méchant, \q et celui qui se dresse contre moi comme l’injuste.
fr.B: Que mon ennemi soit traité comme le méchant, \q et mon adversaire comme l’injuste.
fr.R: Que mon ennemi finisse comme les méchants. \q Que celui qui m’attaque soit traité comme quelqu’un qui fait le mal.

sw.L: Adui yangu na awe kama mwovu, \q na yule anayeinuka dhidi yangu kama dhalimu.
sw.B: Adui yangu na awe kama mtu mwovu, \q na mpinzani wangu kama asiye mwadilifu.
sw.R: Adui yangu na aishie kama waovu. \q Anayenishambulia na atendewe kama mtenda maovu.

vi.L: Nguyện kẻ thù tôi như kẻ ác, \q và kẻ nổi lên chống tôi như kẻ bất chính.
vi.B: Nguyện kẻ thù tôi bị như kẻ ác, \q và kẻ chống đối tôi như kẻ bất công.
vi.R: Nguyện kẻ thù tôi có kết cục như kẻ ác. \q Nguyện kẻ tấn công tôi bị đối xử như kẻ làm điều gian ác.

ko.L: 내 원수는 악인 같고, \q 나를 치려고 일어나는 자는 불의한 자 같기를 바란다.
ko.B: 내 원수가 악인처럼 되고, \q 나를 대적하는 자가 불의한 자처럼 되기를!
ko.R: 내 원수가 악인들처럼 끝장나기를 바란다. \q 나를 공격하는 자가 악을 행하는 자처럼 대접받기를 바란다.

pt.L: Seja o meu inimigo como o perverso, \q e o que se levanta contra mim, como o injusto.
pt.B: Que o meu inimigo seja como o perverso, \q e o meu adversário, como o injusto.
pt.R: Que o meu inimigo acabe como os perversos. \q Que quem me ataca seja tratado como os injustos.

decisions.choice: a wish: may my enemy share the fate of the wicked
alternatives: my enemy is like the wicked (a statement)
decisions.reason: The verb is a wish. Job turns the friends' descriptions of the end of the wicked (chapters 8, 15, 18, 20) on whoever opposes him.

decisions.choice: my enemy, the one who rises against me: whoever accuses him
decisions.reason: In a court the one who "rises up" against someone is the accuser (Deuteronomy 19:16; Psalm 27:12). Job does not name him; the friends, who have charged him with great wickedness (22:5), are near at hand.

decisions.choice: end up like ... be treated like
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that Job wishes his enemy the fate of the wicked, not their character (m1).

source.text: כִּ֤י מַה־תִּקְוַ֣ת חָ֭נֵף כִּ֣י יִבְצָ֑ע כִּ֤י יֵ֖שֶׁל אֱל֣וֹהַּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: For what [is the] hope of [the] godless when he cuts off, when draws out God his life?

en.L: For what [is the] hope of the godless when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cuts [him] off, \q when God takes away his life?
en.B: For what hope does the godless have when God cuts him off, \q when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} takes away his life?
en.R: What hope does a godless person have \q when God ends his life and takes it away?

es.L: Pues ¿cuál [es la] esperanza del impío cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [lo] corta, \q cuando Dios le quita la vida?
es.B: Pues ¿qué esperanza tiene el impío cuando Dios lo corta, \q cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le quita la vida?
es.R: ¿Qué esperanza le queda al que vive sin Dios \q cuando Dios pone fin a su vida y se la quita?

fr.L: Car quel [est l’]espoir de l’impie quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [le] retranche, \q quand Dieu lui retire sa vie ?
fr.B: Car quel espoir reste-t-il à l’impie quand Dieu le retranche, \q quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui ôte la vie ?
fr.R: Quel espoir a l’homme sans Dieu \q quand Dieu met fin à sa vie et la lui reprend ?

sw.L: Kwa maana tumaini la asiyemcha Mungu [ni] nini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anapomkatilia mbali, \q Mungu anapoiondoa roho yake?
sw.B: Kwa maana asiyemcha Mungu ana tumaini gani Mungu anapomkatilia mbali, \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anapoiondoa roho yake?
sw.R: Mtu asiyemcha Mungu ana tumaini gani \q Mungu anapoikomesha roho yake na kuiondoa?

vi.L: Vì kẻ vô đạo có hy vọng gì khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cắt đứt [hắn], \q khi Đức Chúa Trời cất lấy mạng sống hắn?
vi.B: Vì kẻ vô đạo còn hy vọng gì khi Đức Chúa Trời cắt đứt hắn, \q khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lấy đi mạng sống hắn?
vi.R: Kẻ vô đạo còn hy vọng gì \q khi Đức Chúa Trời kết thúc mạng sống hắn và cất nó đi?

ko.L: 그분께서 [그를] 끊으실 때, 경건하지 않은 자에게 무슨 소망이 [있겠느냐]? \q 하나님께서 그의 목숨을 거두어 가실 때에?
ko.B: 하나님께서 경건하지 않은 자를 끊으실 때, \q 그분께서 그의 목숨을 거두실 때, 그에게 무슨 소망이 있겠느냐?
ko.R: 경건하지 않은 사람에게 무슨 소망이 있겠느냐? \q 하나님께서 그의 목숨을 끊어 거두어 가실 때에 말이다.

pt.L: Pois qual [é] a esperança do ímpio quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [o] corta, \q quando Deus lhe tira a vida?
pt.B: Pois que esperança tem o ímpio quando Deus o corta, \q quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe tira a vida?
pt.R: Que esperança tem quem vive sem Deus \q quando Deus põe fim à vida dele e a leva embora?

decisions.choice: cuts off: God ends the life of the godless
alternatives: however much he gains (the same verb means to make a profit)
decisions.reason: The verb can mean to cut off, as a weaver cuts the thread from the loom (Isaiah 38:12), or to gain, often unjustly. The second line, "when God takes away his life", favors cutting off, with God as the subject of both.

decisions.choice: the hope of the godless
decisions.reason: Bildad said that "the hope of the godless will perish" (8:13). Job agrees: a godless person has nothing to hope for at death. He is not such a person (13:16).

decisions.choice: draws out, takes away
decisions.reason: The verb is rare; it means to pull out or draw off, here the life (nefesh) drawn out of a person.

decisions.choice: God named in the first line
alternatives: he cuts off ... when God takes
decisions.reason: Hebrew names God only in the second line. Balanced and Readable name him at once, so that the reader knows who cuts the godless off.

decisions.choice: his life (the godless pictured as a man)
decisions.reason: Job's picture of the wicked here and in 27:13-23 is of a man with sons and widows, so the pronouns stay "he" and "his".

source.text: הַֽ֭צַעֲקָתוֹ יִשְׁמַ֥ע׀אֵ֑ל כִּֽי־תָב֖וֹא עָלָ֣יו צָרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: His cry will hear God when comes upon him distress?

en.L: Will God hear his cry \q when distress comes upon him?
en.B: Will God hear his cry \q when trouble comes upon him?
en.R: When trouble comes on him, \q will God listen when he cries for help?

es.L: ¿Oirá Dios su clamor \q cuando venga sobre él la angustia?
es.B: ¿Escuchará Dios su clamor \q cuando le sobrevenga la desgracia?
es.R: Cuando le llegue la desgracia, \q ¿lo escuchará Dios cuando clame pidiendo ayuda?

fr.L: Dieu entendra-t-il son cri \q quand la détresse viendra sur lui ?
fr.B: Dieu entendra-t-il son cri \q quand le malheur fondra sur lui ?
fr.R: Quand le malheur le frappera, \q Dieu l’écoutera-t-il quand il appellera au secours ?

sw.L: Je, Mungu atakisikia kilio chake \q dhiki itakapomjia?
sw.B: Je, Mungu atasikia kilio chake \q taabu itakapomjia?
sw.R: Taabu itakapomjia, \q je, Mungu atamsikiliza atakapolia akiomba msaada?

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời có nghe tiếng kêu của hắn \q khi tai họa đến trên hắn chăng?
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời có nghe tiếng kêu của hắn \q khi hoạn nạn ập đến trên hắn không?
vi.R: Khi hoạn nạn đến với hắn, \q liệu Đức Chúa Trời có lắng nghe khi hắn kêu cứu không?

ko.L: 그에게 환난이 닥칠 때 \q 하나님께서 그의 부르짖음을 들으시겠느냐?
ko.B: 그에게 고난이 닥칠 때 \q 하나님께서 그의 울부짖음을 들어 주시겠느냐?
ko.R: 그에게 고난이 닥칠 때, \q 그가 도와 달라고 부르짖는다고 하나님께서 들어 주시겠느냐?

pt.L: Acaso Deus ouvirá o seu clamor \q quando a angústia vier sobre ele?
pt.B: Será que Deus ouvirá o seu clamor \q quando a desgraça cair sobre ele?
pt.R: Quando a desgraça cair sobre ele, \q será que Deus vai escutá-lo quando ele gritar por socorro?

decisions.choice: a question expecting "no"
decisions.reason: The question mark at the head of the verse expects the answer no: God will not answer the godless when disaster comes (Proverbs 1:28; Micah 3:4).

decisions.choice: cry: a cry for help in distress
decisions.reason: Tse'aqah is the cry of the oppressed (Exodus 3:7). Job himself cries out and gets no answer (19:7; 30:20), but he does not count himself among the godless.

decisions.choice: the time clause first
alternatives: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes?
decisions.reason: Readable puts the time first, as plain English tends to, without change of sense.

source.text: אִם־עַל־שַׁדַּ֥י יִתְעַנָּ֑ג יִקְרָ֖א אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּכָל־עֵֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: Or on [the] Almighty will he take delight? Will he call [on] God at every time?

en.L: Or will he take delight in the Almighty? \q Will he call on God at all times?
en.B: Will he find delight in the Almighty? \q Will he call on God at all times?
en.R: Will he find his delight in God All-Powerful? \q Will he pray to God all the time?

es.L: ¿O se deleitará en el Todopoderoso? \q ¿Invocará a Dios en todo tiempo?
es.B: ¿Hallará su deleite en el Todopoderoso? \q ¿Invocará a Dios en todo momento?
es.R: ¿Encontrará su alegría en el Dios Todopoderoso? \q ¿Orará a Dios en todo tiempo?

fr.L: Ou bien fera-t-il ses délices du Tout-Puissant ? \q Invoquera-t-il Dieu en tout temps ?
fr.B: Trouvera-t-il son plaisir dans le Tout-Puissant ? \q Invoquera-t-il Dieu en tout temps ?
fr.R: Trouvera-t-il sa joie en Dieu le Tout-Puissant ? \q Priera-t-il Dieu à tout moment ?

sw.L: Au je, atajifurahisha katika Mwenyezi? \q Je, atamwita Mungu nyakati zote?
sw.B: Je, atamfurahia Mwenyezi? \q Je, atamwita Mungu wakati wote?
sw.R: Je, atapata furaha yake kwa Mungu Mwenyezi? \q Je, atamwomba Mungu kila wakati?

vi.L: Hay hắn sẽ vui thích nơi Đấng Toàn Năng? \q Hắn sẽ kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời mọi lúc chăng?
vi.B: Hắn có tìm được niềm vui nơi Đấng Toàn Năng không? \q Hắn có kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời mọi lúc không?
vi.R: Hắn có vui thích nơi Đức Chúa Trời Toàn Năng không? \q Hắn có cầu nguyện với Đức Chúa Trời luôn luôn không?

ko.L: 그가 전능자 안에서 즐거워하겠느냐? \q 언제나 하나님을 부르겠느냐?
ko.B: 그가 전능자를 기뻐하겠느냐? \q 언제든지 하나님을 부르겠느냐?
ko.R: 그가 전능하신 하나님 안에서 기쁨을 찾겠느냐? \q 늘 하나님께 기도하겠느냐?

pt.L: Ou se deleitará ele no Todo-Poderoso? \q Invocará a Deus em todo o tempo?
pt.B: Será que ele terá prazer no Todo-Poderoso? \q Invocará a Deus em todo o tempo?
pt.R: Será que ele vai encontrar alegria no Deus Todo-Poderoso? \q Será que vai orar a Deus o tempo todo?

decisions.choice: delight in the Almighty
decisions.reason: Eliphaz promised Job that if he returned to God he would "delight in the Almighty" (22:26, the same words). Job says that such delight, and steady prayer, belong to the person who truly holds to God, not to the godless.

decisions.choice: call on God at all times: keep praying in every situation
decisions.reason: The godless person may cry out in distress (27:9), but does not keep calling on God. Job, for all his complaint, has never stopped speaking to God.

decisions.choice: pray to
decisions.reason: "Call on God" means to pray to him; Readable says so.

decisions.choice: se deleitará ... no Todo-Poderoso (L)
decisions.reason: The same words as Eliphaz's promise in 22:26 (m1), so Literal repeats the verb used there, "você se deleitará no Todo-Poderoso", and the reader hears Job take it up.

source.text: אוֹרֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֣ם בְּיַד־אֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲכַחֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: I will teach you about [the] hand of God; what [is] with [the] Almighty not I will hide.

en.L: I will teach you about the hand of God; \q what [is] with the Almighty \q I will not hide.
en.B: I will teach you about the power of God; \q what the Almighty has in mind \q I will not hide.
en.R: I will teach you about the power of God. \q I will not hide from you how God All-Powerful works.

es.L: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} instruiré acerca de la mano de Dios; \q lo que [hay] con el Todopoderoso \q no [lo] ocultaré.
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} enseñaré acerca del poder de Dios; \q lo que el Todopoderoso tiene en mente \q no lo ocultaré.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} enseñaré acerca del poder de Dios. \q No {{plural_you:les|os}} ocultaré cómo obra el Dios Todopoderoso.

fr.L: Je vous instruirai sur la main de Dieu ; \q ce qui [est] auprès du Tout-Puissant, \q je ne le cacherai pas.
fr.B: Je vous enseignerai la puissance de Dieu ; \q ce que projette le Tout-Puissant, \q je ne le cacherai pas.
fr.R: Je vais vous enseigner la puissance de Dieu. \q Je ne vous cacherai pas comment agit Dieu le Tout-Puissant.

sw.L: Nitawafundisha juu ya mkono wa Mungu; \q yaliyo kwa Mwenyezi \q sitayaficha.
sw.B: Nitawafundisha juu ya uweza wa Mungu; \q yaliyo moyoni mwa Mwenyezi \q sitayaficha.
sw.R: Nitawafundisha juu ya uweza wa Mungu. \q Sitawaficha jinsi Mungu Mwenyezi anavyotenda kazi.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ dạy các anh về bàn tay của Đức Chúa Trời; \q điều [ở] nơi Đấng Toàn Năng \q tôi sẽ không giấu.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ dạy các anh về quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời; \q điều Đấng Toàn Năng định trong lòng \q tôi sẽ chẳng giấu giếm.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ dạy các anh về quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời. \q Tôi sẽ không giấu các anh cách Đức Chúa Trời Toàn Năng hành động.

ko.L: 내가 하나님의 손에 대해 그대들을 가르치겠소. \q 전능자께 [있는] 것을 \q 나는 숨기지 않겠소.
ko.B: 내가 하나님의 능력에 대해 그대들에게 가르치겠소. \q 전능자께서 마음에 품으신 것을 \q 나는 숨기지 않겠소.
ko.R: 내가 그대들에게 하나님의 능력을 가르쳐 주겠소. \q 전능하신 하나님께서 어떻게 일하시는지 숨기지 않겠소.

pt.L: Eu ensinarei a vocês sobre a mão de Deus; \q o que [está] com o Todo-Poderoso \q não esconderei.
pt.B: Vou ensinar a vocês sobre o poder de Deus; \q o que o Todo-Poderoso tem em mente \q não vou esconder.
pt.R: Vou ensinar a vocês sobre o poder de Deus. \q Não vou esconder de vocês como o Deus Todo-Poderoso age.

decisions.choice: the hand of God: God's power and what he does with it
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power and action (12:9-10; 19:21). Job will speak of what God does.

decisions.choice: what is with the Almighty: God's ways and purposes
decisions.reason: What is "with" someone is what they hold in mind or plan (10:13; 23:14). Job says he knows these as well as the friends.

decisions.choice: you (plural): Job speaks to all three friends
decisions.reason: The pronoun is plural, as in 27:5 and 27:12.

decisions.choice: power ... has in mind (B), how God works (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the pictures mean (m1, m2).

source.text: הֵן־אַתֶּ֣ם כֻּלְּכֶ֣ם חֲזִיתֶ֑ם וְלָמָּה־זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל תֶּהְבָּֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, you, all of you have seen; and why [is] this [that] vanity you become vain?

en.L: Look, you yourselves, all of you, have seen [it]; \q so why then do you become empty [with] emptiness?
en.B: Look, all of you have seen it for yourselves; \q why then do you talk such empty nonsense?
en.R: You have all seen this for yourselves. \q So why do you keep saying things that mean nothing?

es.L: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}}, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, [lo] {{plural_you:han|habéis}} visto; \q ¿por qué, pues, {{plural_you:se vuelven|os volvéis}} vanos [con] vanidad?
es.B: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} lo {{plural_you:han|habéis}} visto con {{plural_you:sus propios ojos|vuestros propios ojos}}; \q ¿por qué, entonces, {{plural_you:dicen|decís}} tales necedades vacías?
es.R: Todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} lo {{plural_you:han|habéis}} visto. \q ¿Por qué, entonces, {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} diciendo cosas sin sentido?

fr.L: Voici, vous-mêmes, vous tous, vous [l’]avez vu ; \q pourquoi donc devenez-vous vains [de] vanité ?
fr.B: Voyez, vous l’avez tous constaté vous-mêmes ; \q pourquoi donc tenez-vous des propos si creux ?
fr.R: Vous l’avez tous vu de vos propres yeux. \q Alors pourquoi continuez-vous à dire des choses qui n’ont aucun sens ?

sw.L: Tazameni, ninyi wenyewe, nyote mmeona; \q basi kwa nini mnakuwa watupu [kwa] utupu?
sw.B: Tazameni, ninyi nyote mmejionea wenyewe; \q kwa nini basi mnasema upuuzi mtupu kama huu?
sw.R: Nyote mmeliona hili wenyewe. \q Basi kwa nini mnaendelea kusema maneno yasiyo na maana?

vi.L: Kìa, chính các anh, tất cả các anh, đã thấy [điều ấy]; \q vậy sao các anh lại trở nên rỗng tuếch [với] điều rỗng tuếch?
vi.B: Kìa, tất cả các anh đều đã tận mắt thấy; \q vậy sao các anh lại nói những lời rỗng tuếch như thế?
vi.R: Chính các anh đều đã thấy điều này. \q Vậy sao các anh cứ nói những lời vô nghĩa?

ko.L: 보시오, 그대들 모두가 친히 [그것을] 보았소. \q 그런데 어찌하여 그대들은 헛된 것으로 헛되이 되었소?
ko.B: 보시오, 그대들 모두 그것을 직접 보았소. \q 그런데 어찌하여 그토록 헛된 말을 하오?
ko.R: 그대들은 모두 이것을 직접 보았소. \q 그런데 왜 계속 아무 뜻도 없는 말을 하오?

pt.L: Eis que vocês mesmos, todos vocês, [o] viram; \q por que, então, vocês se esvaziam [com] coisas vazias?
pt.B: Vejam: todos vocês viram isso com os próprios olhos; \q por que, então, falam tanta coisa vazia e sem sentido?
pt.R: Todos vocês viram isso com os próprios olhos. \q Então por que continuam dizendo coisas que não significam nada?

decisions.choice: become vain with vanity: talk emptily, speak nonsense
decisions.reason: Hevel is breath or vapor, something without substance (Ecclesiastes 1:2). Here noun and verb from the same root are put together: you are puffing out empty breath. Job used the word of their comfort in 21:34.

decisions.choice: you have seen: the friends know how things are
decisions.reason: Job says the friends have seen for themselves how God deals with the wicked, so their charges against him have no ground.

decisions.choice: why then: "this" adds force to the question
decisions.reason: Hebrew adds "this" to a question for emphasis: why ever, why then.

decisions.choice: talk such empty nonsense (B), saying things that mean nothing (R)
decisions.reason: English cannot repeat one word as noun and verb here. Balanced uses "empty" and "nonsense" to keep the force of the wordplay (m1).

source.text: זֶ֤ה׀חֵֽלֶק־אָדָ֖ם רָשָׁ֥ע׀עִם־אֵ֑ל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת עָ֝רִיצִ֗ים מִשַּׁדַּ֥י יִקָּֽחוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: This [is the] portion of a person wicked with God, and [the] inheritance of ruthless [ones] [which] from [the] Almighty they will receive.

en.L: This [is the] portion of a wicked {{gender:person|man}} with God, \q and the inheritance of the ruthless, \q [which] they receive from the Almighty.
en.B: This is the portion a wicked {{gender:person|man}} has from God, \q the inheritance the ruthless receive from the Almighty:
en.R: This is what God has in store for a wicked person. \q This is what cruel people receive from God All-Powerful:

es.L: Esta [es la] porción de {{gender:la persona malvada|el hombre malvado}} de parte de Dios, \q y la herencia de los violentos, \q [que] reciben del Todopoderoso.
es.B: Esta es la porción que {{gender:la persona malvada|el hombre malvado}} recibe de Dios, \q la herencia que los violentos reciben del Todopoderoso:
es.R: Esto es lo que Dios tiene reservado para el malvado. \q Esto es lo que la gente cruel recibe del Dios Todopoderoso:

fr.L: Voici la part de {{gender:la personne méchante|l’homme méchant}} auprès de Dieu, \q et l’héritage des tyrans, \q [qu’]ils reçoivent du Tout-Puissant.
fr.B: Voici la part que {{gender:la personne méchante|l’homme méchant}} reçoit de Dieu, \q l’héritage que les tyrans reçoivent du Tout-Puissant :
fr.R: Voici ce que Dieu réserve au méchant. \q Voici ce que les gens cruels reçoivent de Dieu le Tout-Puissant :

sw.L: Hili [ndilo] fungu la mtu mwovu kwa Mungu, \q na urithi wa wakorofi, \q [ambao] wanaupokea kutoka kwa Mwenyezi.
sw.B: Hili ndilo fungu ambalo mtu mwovu hupata kutoka kwa Mungu, \q urithi ambao wakatili hupokea kutoka kwa Mwenyezi:
sw.R: Hiki ndicho Mungu alichomwekea mtu mwovu. \q Hiki ndicho watu wakatili wanachopokea kutoka kwa Mungu Mwenyezi:

vi.L: Đây [là] phần của người gian ác từ Đức Chúa Trời, \q và cơ nghiệp của những kẻ bạo tàn, \q [mà] chúng nhận lãnh từ Đấng Toàn Năng.
vi.B: Đây là phần mà kẻ gian ác nhận từ Đức Chúa Trời, \q là cơ nghiệp mà kẻ bạo tàn nhận lãnh từ Đấng Toàn Năng:
vi.R: Đây là điều Đức Chúa Trời dành sẵn cho kẻ ác. \q Đây là điều những kẻ tàn bạo nhận từ Đức Chúa Trời Toàn Năng:

ko.L: 이것이 하나님께로부터 [받는] 악한 사람의 몫이요, \q 포악한 자들이 \q 전능자에게서 받는 유산이다.
ko.B: 악한 사람이 하나님께 받을 몫, \q 포악한 자들이 전능자에게서 받을 유산은 이러하다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 악한 사람에게 마련해 두신 것은 이것이다. \q 잔인한 사람들이 전능하신 하나님께 받을 것은 이것이다.

pt.L: Esta [é] a porção do {{gender:ser humano perverso|homem perverso}} junto a Deus, \q e a herança dos tiranos, \q [que] eles recebem do Todo-Poderoso.
pt.B: Esta é a porção que {{gender:a pessoa perversa|o homem perverso}} recebe de Deus, \q a herança que os tiranos recebem do Todo-Poderoso:
pt.R: Isto é o que Deus tem reservado para quem é perverso. \q Isto é o que as pessoas cruéis recebem do Deus Todo-Poderoso:

decisions.choice: Job takes up Zophar's words
decisions.reason: Zophar ended his second speech with nearly the same line: "This is the portion of a wicked person from God, the inheritance appointed him by God" (20:29). Job repeats it and goes on to describe the end of the wicked in the friends' own manner.

decisions.choice: the words are Job's: he grants that God will punish the wicked and turns the warning on his accusers
alternatives: Job is quoting the friends' view in order to mock it
27:13-23 belong to a third speech of Zophar that is missing from the text as we have it
decisions.reason: In 21:7-34 Job said that the wicked often live long and prosper; here he describes their ruin. The text gives these words to Job (27:1), and he has just warned that his enemy should fare like the wicked (27:7). Because Zophar has no third speech and Bildad's is very short (chapter 25), some readers think the speeches of this cycle have been disordered. The Hebrew text as it stands is translated here.

decisions.choice: the ruthless: violent oppressors, tyrants
decisions.reason: 'Aritsim are people who use terror and force (6:23; 15:20, where Eliphaz uses the same pair as here).

decisions.choice: a wicked person (gender setting, with "man" as the alternative), then "he" in 27:14-23
decisions.reason: Adam here means a human being, so the noun takes the gender setting. The picture that follows is of a householder with sons and widows (27:14-15), so the pronouns in 27:14-23 stay "he" and "his" at every level.

decisions.choice: {{gender:la persona malvada|el hombre malvado}}, then masculine pronouns in 27:14-23
decisions.reason: As the English, the noun 'adam takes the gender setting; the householder pictured afterwards keeps masculine forms.

decisions.choice: {{gender:la personne méchante|l’homme méchant}}, then « il » in 27:14-23
decisions.reason: As the English, the noun 'adam takes the gender setting; the picture that follows is of a householder, so the pronouns stay masculine.

decisions.choice: {{gender:ser humano perverso|homem perverso}} (L), {{gender:a pessoa perversa|o homem perverso}} (B); "ele" in 27:14-23
decisions.reason: As the English: the noun takes the gender setting, and the adjective that agrees with it goes under the same span. The man pictured in 27:14-23 has sons and widows, so the pronouns after it stay "ele", as the English keeps "he".

source.text: אִם־יִרְבּ֣וּ בָנָ֣יו לְמוֹ־חָ֑רֶב וְ֝צֶאֱצָאָ֗יו לֹ֣א יִשְׂבְּעוּ־לָֽחֶם׃

records.literal_gloss: If increase his sons, for [the] sword [they are]; and his offspring not will be satisfied [with] bread.

en.L: If his sons become many, [it is] for the sword, \q and his offspring will not be satisfied [with] bread.
en.B: If his children are many, they are destined for the sword, \q and his descendants will never have enough to eat.
en.R: He may have many children, but they will be killed in war. \q His descendants will go hungry.

es.L: Si se multiplican sus hijos, [es] para la espada, \q y sus descendientes no se saciarán [de] pan.
es.B: Aunque tenga muchos hijos, están destinados a la espada, \q y sus descendientes nunca tendrán lo suficiente para comer.
es.R: Puede tener muchos hijos, pero morirán en la guerra. \q Sus descendientes pasarán hambre.

fr.L: Si ses fils se multiplient, [c’est] pour l’épée, \q et sa descendance ne sera pas rassasiée [de] pain.
fr.B: Si ses enfants sont nombreux, ils sont promis à l’épée, \q et ses descendants n’auront jamais de quoi manger.
fr.R: Il aura peut-être beaucoup d’enfants, mais ils seront tués à la guerre. \q Ses descendants souffriront de la faim.

sw.L: Wanawe wakiongezeka, [ni] kwa ajili ya upanga, \q na wazao wake hawatashiba mkate.
sw.B: Hata watoto wake wakiwa wengi, wamewekwa kwa ajili ya upanga, \q na wazao wake hawatapata chakula cha kutosha kamwe.
sw.R: Huenda akawa na watoto wengi, lakini watauawa vitani. \q Wazao wake wataona njaa.

vi.L: Nếu con trai hắn thêm nhiều, [ấy là] để cho gươm, \q và dòng dõi hắn sẽ không được no bánh.
vi.B: Dù con cái hắn đông đúc, chúng cũng dành cho lưỡi gươm, \q và dòng dõi hắn sẽ chẳng bao giờ được ăn no.
vi.R: Hắn có thể có nhiều con, nhưng chúng sẽ bị giết trong chiến tranh. \q Con cháu hắn sẽ phải chịu đói.

ko.L: 그의 아들들이 많아져도 칼을 위한 것이요, \q 그의 자손은 빵으로 배부르지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 그의 자녀가 많아도 칼에 넘겨질 운명이요, \q 그의 자손은 끝내 배불리 먹지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 그가 자식을 많이 둘지라도 그들은 전쟁에서 죽을 것이다. \q 그의 자손은 굶주릴 것이다.

pt.L: Se os seus filhos se multiplicarem, [será] para a espada, \q e os seus descendentes não se fartarão de pão.
pt.B: Ainda que tenha muitos filhos, eles estão destinados à espada, \q e os seus descendentes nunca terão o bastante para comer.
pt.R: Ele pode ter muitos filhos, mas eles vão morrer na guerra. \q Os seus descendentes vão passar fome.

decisions.choice: if ... for the sword: the more children, the more for the sword
decisions.reason: "If" here means "even if" or "however many": a large family, a sign of blessing, will only give more victims to violence (compare 5:4; 18:19; 20:10).

decisions.choice: his sons: his children, his line
decisions.reason: Banim is "sons", and the next line speaks more widely of his offspring: his whole family line will suffer.

decisions.choice: not satisfied with bread: they will go hungry
decisions.reason: Bread stands for food in general.

decisions.choice: killed in war
decisions.reason: The sword stands for violent death, in war or by the hand of enemies; Readable says what it means.

source.text: שְׂ֭רִידָיו בַּמָּ֣וֶת יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃

records.literal_gloss: His survivors by death will be buried, and his widows not will weep.

en.L: His survivors will be buried by death, \q and his widows will not weep.
en.B: Those who survive him will be buried by the plague, \q and his widows will not mourn.
en.R: Those of his family who are left will die of disease and be buried, \q and his widows will not even cry for them.

es.L: Sus sobrevivientes serán sepultados por la muerte, \q y sus viudas no llorarán.
es.B: Los que le sobrevivan serán sepultados por la peste, \q y sus viudas no harán duelo.
es.R: Los de su familia que queden morirán de enfermedad y serán sepultados, \q y sus viudas ni siquiera llorarán por ellos.

fr.L: Ses survivants seront ensevelis par la mort, \q et ses veuves ne pleureront pas.
fr.B: Ceux qui lui survivront seront ensevelis par la peste, \q et ses veuves ne prendront pas le deuil.
fr.R: Ceux de sa famille qui resteront mourront de maladie et seront enterrés, \q et ses veuves ne pleureront même pas sur eux.

sw.L: Waliosalia wake watazikwa na mauti, \q na wajane wake hawatalia.
sw.B: Wale watakaosalia baada yake watazikwa na tauni, \q na wajane wake hawataomboleza.
sw.R: Watu wa jamaa yake watakaobaki watakufa kwa ugonjwa na kuzikwa, \q na wajane wake hawatawalilia hata kidogo.

vi.L: Những kẻ sống sót của hắn sẽ bị chôn bởi sự chết, \q và các góa phụ của hắn sẽ không khóc.
vi.B: Những kẻ còn lại sau hắn sẽ bị dịch bệnh chôn vùi, \q và các góa phụ của hắn sẽ chẳng khóc than.
vi.R: Những người còn lại trong gia đình hắn sẽ chết vì bệnh tật và bị chôn, \q và các góa phụ của hắn cũng chẳng khóc thương họ.

ko.L: 그의 남은 자들은 죽음으로 묻히고, \q 그의 과부들은 울지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 살아남은 자들은 역병으로 묻히고, \q 그의 과부들은 애곡하지도 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그의 집안에 남은 사람들은 병으로 죽어 묻히고, \q 그의 과부들은 그들을 위해 울지도 않을 것이다.

pt.L: Os seus sobreviventes serão sepultados pela morte, \q e as suas viúvas não chorarão.
pt.B: Os que sobreviverem a ele serão sepultados pela peste, \q e as suas viúvas não farão luto.
pt.R: Os que sobrarem da família dele vão morrer de doença e ser enterrados, \q e as viúvas dele nem vão chorar por eles.

decisions.choice: death: deadly disease, plague
decisions.reason: Death here, as in Jeremiah 15:2 and 18:21, is a deadly disease that sweeps people away. Those who escape the sword (27:14) fall to plague.

decisions.choice: his widows do not weep: there are no proper mourning rites
decisions.reason: To be buried without the mourning of one's family was a mark of disgrace and disaster; Psalm 78:64 uses the same words. The plural "widows" fits a wealthy man with more than one wife.

decisions.choice: the plague
decisions.reason: "Buried by death" makes little sense in English; Balanced names the deadly disease meant (m1).

source.text: אִם־יִצְבֹּ֣ר כֶּעָפָ֣ר כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝כַחֹ֗מֶר יָכִ֥ין מַלְבּֽוּשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: If he heaps up like dust silver, and like clay he prepares clothing,

en.L: If he heaps up silver like dust, \q and lays up clothing like clay,
en.B: Though he piles up silver like dust \q and stores up clothes like heaps of clay,
en.R: He may pile up silver like dust \q and stack up clothes like piles of clay.

es.L: Si amontona plata como polvo, \q y prepara ropa como barro,
es.B: Aunque amontone plata como polvo \q y acumule ropa como montones de barro,
es.R: Puede amontonar plata como si fuera polvo \q y apilar ropa como montones de barro.

fr.L: S’il amasse l’argent comme la poussière, \q et prépare des vêtements comme l’argile,
fr.B: Même s’il entasse l’argent comme la poussière \q et amasse des habits comme des tas d’argile,
fr.R: Il peut bien entasser l’argent comme de la poussière \q et empiler les vêtements comme des tas d’argile.

sw.L: Ajapojilimbikizia fedha kama mavumbi, \q na kujiwekea mavazi kama udongo,
sw.B: Ingawa anarundika fedha kama mavumbi \q na kujiwekea nguo kama malundo ya udongo,
sw.R: Huenda akarundika fedha kama mavumbi \q na kupanga nguo kama malundo ya udongo.

vi.L: Nếu hắn chất bạc như bụi đất, \q và sắm sửa áo xống như đất sét,
vi.B: Dù hắn chất bạc như bụi đất \q và tích trữ áo quần như những đống đất sét,
vi.R: Hắn có thể chất bạc như bụi đất \q và xếp áo quần như những đống đất sét.

ko.L: 그가 은을 티끌처럼 쌓고, \q 옷을 진흙처럼 마련할지라도,
ko.B: 그가 은을 티끌처럼 쌓아 올리고 \q 옷을 진흙 더미처럼 쌓아 둘지라도,
ko.R: 그가 은을 티끌처럼 쌓아 올리고 \q 옷을 진흙 더미처럼 쌓아 둘 수도 있다.

pt.L: Se ele amontoar prata como pó \q e preparar roupas como barro,
pt.B: Ainda que ele junte prata como se fosse pó \q e acumule roupas como montes de barro,
pt.R: Ele pode juntar prata como quem junta pó \q e empilhar roupas como montes de barro.

decisions.choice: like dust, like clay: in huge amounts
decisions.reason: Dust and clay are what there is most of. Zechariah 9:3 uses the same picture: Tyre "heaped up silver like dust, and gold like the mud of the streets".

decisions.choice: clothing: a form of wealth
decisions.reason: Fine garments were stored and given as wealth (Genesis 45:22; Joshua 7:21; 2 Kings 5:5, 22).

decisions.choice: heaps of clay (B), piles of clay (R)
decisions.reason: "Heaps" and "piles" make the point of the comparison, the amount, clear in English.

source.text: יָ֭כִין וְצַדִּ֣יק יִלְבָּ֑שׁ וְ֝כֶ֗סֶף נָקִ֥י יַחֲלֹֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: he will prepare [it], but [the] righteous will wear [it], and [the] silver [the] innocent will divide.

en.L: he may lay [it] up, but the righteous will wear [it], \q and the innocent will divide the silver.
en.B: he may store them up, but the righteous will wear them, \q and the innocent will divide up the silver.
en.R: But good people will wear his clothes, \q and innocent people will share his silver.

es.L: él [la] preparará, pero el justo [la] vestirá, \q y el inocente repartirá la plata.
es.B: él podrá acumularla, pero el justo se la pondrá, \q y el inocente se repartirá la plata.
es.R: Pero la gente buena usará su ropa, \q y los inocentes se repartirán su plata.

fr.L: il [les] préparera, mais le juste [les] portera, \q et l’innocent partagera l’argent.
fr.B: il peut bien les amasser, c’est le juste qui les portera, \q et l’innocent qui se partagera l’argent.
fr.R: Mais ce sont les gens de bien qui porteront ses habits, \q et les innocents qui se partageront son argent.

sw.L: atajiwekea, lakini mwenye haki [ndiye] atakayeyavaa, \q na asiye na hatia atagawanya fedha.
sw.B: anaweza kuzirundika, lakini mwenye haki atazivaa, \q na asiye na hatia ataigawanya fedha.
sw.R: Lakini watu wema watavaa nguo zake, \q na watu wasio na hatia watagawana fedha yake.

vi.L: hắn sắm sửa, nhưng người công chính sẽ mặc [chúng], \q và người vô tội sẽ chia nhau bạc.
vi.B: hắn có thể tích trữ, nhưng người công chính sẽ mặc, \q và người vô tội sẽ chia nhau số bạc ấy.
vi.R: Nhưng người tốt sẽ mặc áo quần của hắn, \q và người vô tội sẽ chia nhau bạc của hắn.

ko.L: 그가 마련해도 의인이 [그것을] 입고, \q 죄 없는 자가 그 은을 나눌 것이다.
ko.B: 그가 쌓아 두어도 의인이 그 옷을 입고, \q 죄 없는 자가 그 은을 나누어 가질 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 그의 옷은 선한 사람들이 입고, \q 그의 은은 죄 없는 사람들이 나누어 가질 것이다.

pt.L: ele [as] prepara, mas o justo [as] vestirá, \q e o inocente repartirá a prata.
pt.B: ele pode guardá-las, mas é o justo que vai vesti-las, \q e o inocente vai repartir a prata.
pt.R: Mas as pessoas boas é que vão vestir as roupas dele, \q e as pessoas inocentes vão repartir a prata dele.

decisions.choice: the wealth of the wicked passes to the righteous
decisions.reason: A common teaching of the wise: "the sinner's wealth is stored up for the righteous" (Proverbs 13:22; 28:8; Ecclesiastes 2:26).

decisions.choice: he may store it up: the verb picks up the end of 27:16
decisions.reason: The verb that ends 27:16 opens 27:17. The wicked man prepares, but others enjoy what he prepared.

decisions.choice: good people ... innocent people
decisions.reason: Readable uses plain words; the Hebrew terms are singular but stand for the whole class.

source.text: בָּנָ֣ה כָעָ֣שׁ בֵּית֑וֹ וּ֝כְסֻכָּ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה נֹצֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: He has built like the moth his house, and like a booth [that] has made a watchman.

en.L: He has built his house like the moth, \q and like a hut [that] a watchman has made.
en.B: The house he builds is like a moth's cocoon, \q like a shelter put up by a watchman.
en.R: The house he builds is as weak as a moth's cocoon, \q as flimsy as a hut that a field guard puts up.

es.L: Ha edificado su casa como la polilla, \q y como choza [que] hace un guarda.
es.B: La casa que construye es como el capullo de la polilla, \q como la choza que levanta un guarda.
es.R: La casa que construye es tan frágil como el capullo de una polilla, \q tan endeble como la choza que levanta el guardián de un campo.

fr.L: Il a bâti sa maison comme la teigne, \q et comme une hutte [que] fait un gardien.
fr.B: La maison qu’il bâtit est comme le cocon de la teigne, \q comme l’abri que dresse un gardien.
fr.R: La maison qu’il bâtit est aussi fragile qu’un cocon de teigne, \q aussi frêle qu’une cabane dressée par le gardien d’un champ.

sw.L: Amejenga nyumba yake kama nondo, \q na kama kibanda [ambacho] mlinzi amekijenga.
sw.B: Nyumba anayoijenga ni kama kifukofuko cha nondo, \q kama kibanda kilichojengwa na mlinzi.
sw.R: Nyumba anayoijenga ni dhaifu kama kifukofuko cha nondo, \q haina nguvu kama kibanda anachojenga mlinzi wa shamba.

vi.L: Hắn đã xây nhà mình như con mọt, \q và như cái chòi [mà] người canh gác dựng lên.
vi.B: Ngôi nhà hắn xây giống như cái kén của con mọt, \q như cái chòi người canh gác dựng lên.
vi.R: Ngôi nhà hắn xây mong manh như cái kén của con mọt, \q yếu ớt như cái chòi người canh ruộng dựng tạm.

ko.L: 그는 자기 집을 좀처럼 짓고, \q 파수꾼이 만든 초막처럼 [지었다].
ko.B: 그가 짓는 집은 좀나방의 고치 같고, \q 파수꾼이 세운 움막 같다.
ko.R: 그가 짓는 집은 좀나방의 고치처럼 약하고, \q 밭 지키는 사람이 세운 움막처럼 허술하다.

pt.L: Ele construiu a sua casa como a traça, \q e como uma cabana [que] um vigia fez.
pt.B: A casa que ele constrói é como o casulo da traça, \q como o abrigo que um vigia levanta.
pt.R: A casa que ele constrói é fraca como o casulo de uma traça, \q frágil como a cabana que um vigia de lavoura levanta.

decisions.choice: like the moth: as frail as the case a moth builds
decisions.reason: A moth's "house" is its cocoon, a flimsy thing; the moth is a picture of frailty in 4:19 and 13:28. Some ancient translations speak of a spider here, as in Bildad's picture of the godless person's trust as a spider's house (8:14).

decisions.choice: a watchman's hut: a temporary shelter in a field or vineyard
decisions.reason: At harvest a guard watched the crop from a booth of branches, put up for a season and then left to fall (Isaiah 1:8; 24:20).

decisions.choice: cocoon
decisions.reason: "Built his house like the moth" could be read as the moth eating the house. Balanced and Readable name the moth's house, the cocoon (m1).

source.text: עָשִׁ֣יר יִ֭שְׁכַּב וְלֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑ף עֵינָ֖יו פָּקַ֣ח וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Rich he lies down, and not he will be gathered; his eyes he opens, and he [is] not.

en.L: Rich he lies down, but he will not be gathered; \q he opens his eyes, and he is no more.
en.B: He lies down rich, but he will not be gathered to his ancestors; \q he opens his eyes, and he is gone.
en.R: He goes to bed rich, but he will not be buried with his family. \q In a moment he is gone.

es.L: Rico se acuesta, pero no será recogido; \q abre sus ojos, y ya no está.
es.B: Se acuesta rico, pero no será reunido con sus antepasados; \q abre los ojos, y ya no existe.
es.R: Se va a dormir rico, pero no será sepultado con su familia. \q En un instante desaparece.

fr.L: Riche il se couche, mais il ne sera pas recueilli ; \q il ouvre les yeux, et il n’est plus.
fr.B: Il se couche riche, mais il ne sera pas réuni à ses ancêtres ; \q il ouvre les yeux, et il a disparu.
fr.R: Il se couche riche, mais il ne sera pas enterré avec les siens. \q En un instant il a disparu.

sw.L: Hulala akiwa tajiri, lakini hatakusanywa; \q hufumbua macho yake, naye hayupo.
sw.B: Hulala akiwa tajiri, lakini hatakusanywa kwa baba zake; \q hufumbua macho, naye ametoweka.
sw.R: Huenda kulala akiwa tajiri, lakini hatazikwa pamoja na jamaa yake. \q Mara moja ametoweka.

vi.L: Hắn giàu có nằm xuống, nhưng sẽ không được thu về; \q hắn mở mắt ra, thì không còn nữa.
vi.B: Hắn nằm xuống giàu có, nhưng sẽ không được về với tổ tiên; \q hắn mở mắt ra, thì đã chẳng còn.
vi.R: Hắn đi ngủ khi còn giàu có, nhưng sẽ không được chôn cùng gia đình. \q Chỉ trong chốc lát, hắn đã biến mất.

ko.L: 부자로 눕지만 거두어지지 못하고, \q 눈을 뜨면 그는 없다.
ko.B: 그는 부자로 잠자리에 들지만 조상에게로 돌아가지 못하고, \q 눈을 떠 보면 이미 사라지고 없다.
ko.R: 그는 부자로 잠자리에 들지만, 가족과 함께 묻히지 못한다. \q 한순간에 그는 사라진다.

pt.L: Rico ele se deita, mas não será recolhido; \q ele abre os olhos, e não existe mais.
pt.B: Ele se deita rico, mas não será reunido aos seus antepassados; \q abre os olhos, e já se foi.
pt.R: Ele vai dormir rico, mas não será sepultado com a sua família. \q De repente ele desaparece.

decisions.choice: not gathered: not laid to rest with his ancestors
alternatives: he will not do so again (the reading of some ancient translations)
his wealth will not be gathered in
decisions.reason: "To be gathered" is said of dying and being buried with one's people (Numbers 20:26; Genesis 25:8), and "not gathered" of the dead left unburied (Jeremiah 8:2; Ezekiel 29:5). The ancient Greek translation reads "he will not add", that is, he will lie down rich no more, from a word with almost the same letters. The Hebrew text is translated here.

decisions.choice: he opens his eyes, and he is gone: sudden ruin
alternatives: he opens his eyes and his wealth is gone
decisions.reason: The picture is of a man who lies down at night rich and secure, and is swept away before he knows it (27:20). "He is not" is said of someone who has vanished or died (7:8, 21).

decisions.choice: to his ancestors (B), buried with his family (R)
decisions.reason: "Gathered" alone would mean little to an English reader; Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means (m1).

decisions.choice: In a moment
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the picture, how suddenly the end comes (m2).

source.text: תַּשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ כַ֭מַּיִם בַּלָּה֑וֹת לַ֝֗יְלָה גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Overtake him like waters terrors; [by] night steals him away a storm.

en.L: Terrors overtake him like waters; \q [by] night a storm steals him away.
en.B: Terrors overtake him like a flood; \q in the night a storm carries him off.
en.R: Terrors sweep over him like a flood. \q A storm carries him away in the night.

es.L: Lo alcanzan como aguas los terrores; \q [de] noche lo arrebata una tormenta.
es.B: Los terrores lo alcanzan como una inundación; \q de noche una tormenta se lo lleva.
es.R: Los terrores lo arrasan como una inundación. \q Una tormenta se lo lleva en la noche.

fr.L: Les terreurs l’atteignent comme des eaux ; \q [de] nuit une tempête l’enlève.
fr.B: Les terreurs le submergent comme une inondation ; \q pendant la nuit une tempête l’emporte.
fr.R: Les terreurs le submergent comme une inondation. \q Une tempête l’emporte dans la nuit.

sw.L: Vitisho vinampata kama maji; \q usiku dhoruba inamnyakua.
sw.B: Vitisho vinamfikia kama mafuriko; \q usiku dhoruba inamchukua.
sw.R: Vitisho vinamgharikisha kama mafuriko. \q Dhoruba inamchukua usiku.

vi.L: Những nỗi kinh hoàng đuổi kịp hắn như nước; \q [ban] đêm một trận bão cuốn hắn đi.
vi.B: Những nỗi kinh hoàng ập đến trên hắn như nước lũ; \q trong đêm một trận bão cuốn hắn đi.
vi.R: Nỗi kinh hoàng tràn qua hắn như lũ lụt. \q Một trận bão cuốn hắn đi trong đêm.

ko.L: 두려움들이 물처럼 그를 덮치고, \q 밤에 폭풍이 그를 훔쳐 간다.
ko.B: 공포가 홍수처럼 그를 덮치고, \q 밤중에 폭풍이 그를 휩쓸어 간다.
ko.R: 공포가 홍수처럼 그를 휩쓴다. \q 밤에 폭풍이 그를 날려 보낸다.

pt.L: Terrores o alcançam como águas; \q [de] noite uma tempestade o arrebata.
pt.B: Terrores o alcançam como uma enchente; \q durante a noite uma tempestade o arrebata.
pt.R: Os terrores caem sobre ele como uma enchente. \q Uma tempestade o leva embora durante a noite.

decisions.choice: terrors: sudden, deadly dread
decisions.reason: Ballahot are the terrors that come with death and disaster; Bildad called death "the king of terrors" (18:11, 14).

decisions.choice: like waters: like a flood
decisions.reason: Floodwaters stand for overwhelming disaster (22:11; Psalm 69:2).

decisions.choice: a storm, a whirlwind
decisions.reason: Sufah is a violent storm wind; the wicked are "like chaff that the storm carries away" (21:18).

decisions.choice: a flood
decisions.reason: English "like waters" does not suggest danger; "a flood" does (m2).

source.text: יִשָּׂאֵ֣הוּ קָדִ֣ים וְיֵלַ֑ךְ וִֽ֝ישָׂעֲרֵ֗הוּ מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Lifts him up [the] east wind and he goes, and it sweeps him away from his place.

en.L: The east wind lifts him up, and he is gone; \q it sweeps him away from his place.
en.B: The east wind picks him up, and he is gone; \q it sweeps him away from his place.
en.R: The hot desert wind picks him up, and he is gone. \q It blows him away from his home.

es.L: Lo levanta el viento del este, y se va; \q lo barre de su lugar.
es.B: El viento del este lo levanta, y desaparece; \q lo arrastra lejos de su lugar.
es.R: El viento ardiente del desierto lo levanta, y desaparece. \q Lo arranca de su hogar.

fr.L: Le vent d’est l’enlève, et il s’en va ; \q il le balaie de sa place.
fr.B: Le vent d’est le soulève, et il disparaît ; \q il l’arrache à sa place.
fr.R: Le vent brûlant du désert le soulève, et il disparaît. \q Il l’emporte loin de chez lui.

sw.L: Upepo wa mashariki unamwinua, naye anaondoka; \q unamfagilia mbali kutoka mahali pake.
sw.B: Upepo wa mashariki unamnyanyua, naye ametoweka; \q unamfagilia mbali kutoka mahali pake.
sw.R: Upepo wa joto wa jangwani unamnyanyua, naye ametoweka. \q Unampeperusha mbali na nyumbani kwake.

vi.L: Gió đông nhấc hắn lên, và hắn đi mất; \q nó quét hắn khỏi chỗ của hắn.
vi.B: Gió đông cuốn hắn lên, và hắn biến mất; \q nó quét hắn khỏi chốn ở của hắn.
vi.R: Gió nóng từ sa mạc cuốn hắn lên, và hắn biến mất. \q Nó thổi hắn bay khỏi nhà mình.

ko.L: 동풍이 그를 들어 올리니 그가 가 버리고, \q 그것이 그를 그의 처소에서 쓸어 간다.
ko.B: 동풍이 그를 들어 올리면 그는 사라지고, \q 바람이 그를 그의 자리에서 쓸어 가 버린다.
ko.R: 사막의 뜨거운 바람이 그를 들어 올리니 그는 사라진다. \q 바람이 그를 그의 집에서 날려 보낸다.

pt.L: O vento oriental o levanta, e ele se vai; \q e o varre do seu lugar.
pt.B: O vento oriental o levanta, e ele se vai; \q ele o varre do seu lugar.
pt.R: O vento quente do deserto o levanta, e ele desaparece. \q O vento o arranca da sua casa.

decisions.choice: the east wind: the scorching wind from the desert
decisions.reason: In the lands of the Bible the east wind blows hot and dry from the desert; it withers and destroys (Genesis 41:6; Hosea 13:15; Job 15:2; 38:24).

decisions.choice: from his place: gone from his home for good
decisions.reason: Job used the same words of the dead: "his place will not know him any more" (7:10; see 8:18; 20:9).

decisions.choice: the hot desert wind
decisions.reason: Readable says what kind of wind the east wind is (m1).

source.text: וְיַשְׁלֵ֣ךְ עָ֭לָיו וְלֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל מִ֝יָּד֗וֹ בָּר֥וֹחַ יִבְרָֽח׃

records.literal_gloss: And it throws at him and not it spares; from its hand fleeing he flees.

en.L: It hurls [itself] at him and does not spare; \q he flees headlong from its hand.
en.B: It hurls itself at him without mercy, \q as he flees headlong from its power.
en.R: It strikes him without mercy \q while he tries hard to escape its power.

es.L: Se lanza contra él y no perdona; \q huye a toda prisa de su mano.
es.B: Se arroja contra él sin piedad, \q mientras él huye a toda prisa de su poder.
es.R: Lo golpea sin compasión \q mientras él se esfuerza por escapar de su fuerza.

fr.L: Il se jette sur lui et n’épargne pas ; \q il fuit, il fuit loin de sa main.
fr.B: Il se jette sur lui sans pitié, \q tandis qu’il fuit éperdument devant sa puissance.
fr.R: Il le frappe sans pitié \q pendant qu’il fait tout pour échapper à sa force.

sw.L: Unajirusha juu yake wala hauna huruma; \q yeye anakimbia mbio kutoka mkononi mwake.
sw.B: Unajitupa juu yake bila huruma, \q naye anakimbia kwa nguvu zake zote kuepuka uweza wake.
sw.R: Unampiga bila huruma \q huku akijitahidi kuukimbia uweza wake.

vi.L: Nó lao [mình] vào hắn mà không thương xót; \q hắn chạy trốn hốt hoảng khỏi tay nó.
vi.B: Nó lao vào hắn không chút xót thương, \q trong khi hắn cuống cuồng chạy trốn khỏi sức mạnh của nó.
vi.R: Nó đánh hắn không thương xót \q trong lúc hắn cố sức trốn khỏi sức mạnh của nó.

ko.L: 그것이 그에게 [자신을] 내던지고 아끼지 않으니, \q 그는 그 손에서 급히 달아난다.
ko.B: 바람이 사정없이 그에게 덮쳐 오니, \q 그는 그 힘에서 벗어나려고 정신없이 달아난다.
ko.R: 바람이 그를 사정없이 내리치고, \q 그는 그 힘에서 벗어나려고 안간힘을 쓴다.

pt.L: [O vento] se lança contra ele e não [o] poupa; \q da sua mão ele foge às pressas.
pt.B: O vento se lança contra ele sem piedade, \q enquanto ele foge às pressas do seu poder.
pt.R: O vento o atinge sem piedade, \q enquanto ele tenta de todo jeito escapar da sua força.

decisions.choice: the subject is the wind of 27:21
decisions.reason: The verbs have no named subject. The east wind is the last one named, and it goes on in 27:23. Some read God as the one who throws, as in 6:4 and 16:13 where God's arrows strike Job; either way the storm is God's judgment.

decisions.choice: fleeing he flees: he runs for his life
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for force: he flees with all his might, and in vain.

decisions.choice: from its hand: from its power
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power (27:11).

decisions.choice: hurls itself
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb has no object; Literal brackets "itself" and Balanced supplies it to make English sense.

decisions.choice: [O vento] (L); O vento (B), also in 27:23
decisions.reason: The verbs have no named subject; the east wind of 27:21 is meant (m1). English can say "it", but Portuguese "ele" would be read as the wicked man himself, who is "ele" in the same lines, so Literal brackets "o vento" and Balanced names it.

source.text: יִשְׂפֹּ֣ק עָלֵ֣ימוֹ כַפֵּ֑ימוֹ וְיִשְׁרֹ֥ק עָ֝לָ֗יו מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Claps at him his hands, and hisses at him from his place.

en.L: It claps its hands at him \q and hisses at him from his place.
en.B: It claps its hands at him \q and hisses at him from his place.
en.R: It claps and hisses at him in scorn \q as he is driven from his home.

es.L: Bate sus palmas contra él \q y le silba desde su lugar.
es.B: Aplaude contra él \q y le silba desde su lugar.
es.R: Aplaude y le silba con desprecio \q mientras es arrojado de su hogar.

fr.L: Il bat des mains contre lui \q et siffle contre lui depuis sa place.
fr.B: Il applaudit contre lui \q et le siffle depuis sa place.
fr.R: Il applaudit et le siffle avec mépris \q tandis qu’il est chassé de chez lui.

sw.L: Unampigia makofi \q na kumzomea kutoka mahali pake.
sw.B: Unampigia makofi \q na kumzomea kutoka mahali pake.
sw.R: Unampigia makofi na kumzomea kwa dharau \q anapofukuzwa kutoka nyumbani kwake.

vi.L: Nó vỗ tay trước hắn \q và huýt gió chế giễu hắn từ chỗ của hắn.
vi.B: Nó vỗ tay nhạo hắn \q và huýt gió chê cười hắn từ chỗ ở của hắn.
vi.R: Nó vỗ tay và huýt gió khinh miệt hắn \q khi hắn bị đuổi khỏi nhà mình.

ko.L: 그것이 그를 향해 손뼉을 치고 \q 그의 처소에서 그를 향해 휘파람을 분다.
ko.B: 바람이 그를 향해 손뼉을 치며 \q 그의 자리에서 그를 비웃는 휘파람을 분다.
ko.R: 그가 자기 집에서 쫓겨날 때 \q 바람이 손뼉 치고 휘파람 불며 그를 비웃는다.

pt.L: [O vento] bate palmas contra ele \q e assobia contra ele do seu lugar.
pt.B: O vento bate palmas contra ele \q e assobia contra ele do seu lugar.
pt.R: O vento bate palmas e assobia contra ele, zombando dele, \q enquanto ele é expulso da sua casa.

decisions.choice: clapping and hissing: scorn at someone's ruin
decisions.reason: People clapped their hands and hissed over a fallen city or person to show contempt (Lamentations 2:15; Jeremiah 19:8; Zephaniah 2:15; Nahum 3:19).

decisions.choice: the wind, pictured as a person, mocks him
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject. The wind of 27:21-22 is the most likely, pictured as a person. It may also be impersonal, "people clap", the scorn of those who see his fall.

decisions.choice: his place: the man's home
decisions.reason: "His place" most likely means the home he is swept from, as in 27:21.

decisions.choice: in scorn / as he is driven
alternatives: claps its hands at him and hisses
